# truenas_filesystem_permissions (Data Source)

Reads the current UNIX mode/owner/group of a filesystem path via filesystem.stat.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Absolute filesystem path to look up.

### Read-Only

- `gid` (Number) Numeric group ID of the path's group owner.
- `id` (String) Same as "path".
- `mode` (String) UNIX permission bits in octal string form, e.g. "0750".
- `uid` (Number) Numeric user ID of the path's owner.
